title: Double the sum
hints: Right now the body is read as `(double a) + b`. The call grabs `a` before `+` gets a turn.
You want `double` to get the whole sum as its one argument. Group the sum.
explain: A call takes the value right next to it before any operator runs, so `double a + b` doubles only `a`. Parentheses group `a + b` into one argument: `double (a + b)`.
